entities.summary: Museum of Fight for Estonia's Freedom is a privately owned museum in Lagedi, near Tallinn. It specialises on exhibits of World War II battles on Estonian soil, or involving Estonian soldiers. As of 2014, the museum owned the only working T-34/85 tank in Estonia.
